title: bazis-product/1: spec/product.yaml
description: The product spec of a Bazis product: its roles, its entities (resources of the backend with their fields, workflow and access) and its scenarios. `bazis_front check` validates it against contract/contract.json.

name.description: The name of the product, the title of its frontend.

packages.description: The Bazis packages the backend installs; each must have its section in the capabilities of the contract.

languages.description: The languages of the interface: the codes of LANGUAGES of the backend. Optional; `bazis_front check` compares them with `project.languages` of the contract.

language.description: The default language of the interface: the code of LANGUAGES of the backend that its LANGUAGE_CODE names, one of `languages`. Optional; `bazis_front check` compares it with `project.language` of the contract.

navigation.description: The links of the navigation of the frontend, in their order, and their groups (the screens without an item in their route, not forms: S030). Without it: the home, then for each entity in the order of `entities` its list, its board, its calendar and its reports (a list with `filter`), but the screens with `nav: false`. The icon of a link is by default that of its entity (`icons` of spec/design/theme.yaml): `square-kanban` for a board, `calendar-days` for a calendar, `list-filter` for a report, `house` for the home.

id.description: The id of a role, entity, screen, action or scenario.

text.description: A text of the interface: a key of the dictionaries of the frontend (lowercase words joined by dots, no space: `tiles.on_hand`), a text in the default language (`language`), or the text in each language (`{en: Library, ru: Библиотека}`); `check` warns about a text that is not in every language of `languages` (S027).

icon.description: The name of a lucide icon (lucide.dev), in kebab-case (D013).

nav_link.description: The link of a screen (`nav:<screen>`), labelled by its `label`, else by the title of the screen. It is shown to the users whom the backend lets view the items of the route set of its entity (and filter them by the fields of `list.filter` of a report); `requires.can: add` asks that they may add one too.

label.description: The text of the link, shorter than the title of its screen (`Catalog` for `Book catalog`).

nav_group.description: Links under a heading of the navigation.

field_id.description: The name of a field of the resource in the API.

status_id.description: The id of a status or a transit of bazis-statusy (as stored: a transit created without an id gets one such as `task#draft_to_done` or `task#draft_to_done#1`). Any characters but `.`, which separates the segments of a permission, and white space.

selector.description: Whose objects: `all`, `none` (not granted), `self` (the object is the selector source itself, such as the user), or a selector of bazis-permit: a relationship of the resource that links the object to the user (`author`, `org_owner`), or a path of relationships to it (`parent__author`). Letters and underscores only, as bazis-permit parses a selector.

type.description: The type of a field: string, text (a long string), integer, number, boolean, date, datetime, time, json (an object or an array), point (a PointField of the model: a GeoJSON point), or file (a to-one relationship to the uploaded files of bazis-uploadable).

permit.description: The slug of the permit role (`Role.slug` of bazis-permit); for an anonymous role, a role `for_anonymous`, or none when the guests use only public routes and actions.

anonymous.description: The users who do not log in (the guests of a public site): bazis-permit gives them the permissions of its roles `for_anonymous`; the end-to-end tests of the scenarios of the role log in as nobody.

test_user.description: The user the end-to-end tests log in as.

field.description: An attribute (`type`) or a relationship (`relation`: the id of the entity it references, `many`) of the resource.

display.description: How the screens show the value of an attribute (the components take it, `display`): `plain`, a number without the separators of its thousands (a code of five digits or more; a number below 10,000, such as a year, has none without it); `{currency: <ISO 4217 code>}`, a sum in the currency; `{unit: <text>}`, a quantity followed by its unit; `{bar: <maximum>}`, a number as a bar of its share of the maximum; `phone`, a phone number to call. `bazis_front check` checks it against the type of the field (S020): a number is `integer` or `number` (a sum or a quantity also a `string`, a DecimalField), a phone a `string`.

workflow.description: The statuses and transits of bazis-statusy for the resource. An entity with a workflow has the field `status`.

payload.description: The transit requires a payload with these fields.

grant.description: A selector, or a selector limited to statuses of the workflow.

granted.description: A grant other than `none`: an item of a list of grants.

grants.description: A grant, or a list of grants: the role may do the operation on the objects of any of them, as bazis-permit unites the permissions of a role (`view: [author, participants]`); each is a permission of its own.

transit_selectors.description: The selector of a transit, or a list of selectors (any of them).

access.description: What each role may do with the entity; compiled to the permissions of bazis-permit that the role must have. Unlisted operations are not granted.

transit.description: The transits the role may run: a list (selector `all`) or a selector (or a list of selectors) by transit.

resource.description: The JSON:API type of the resource (`app.model`), as in contract.json.

title.description: The name of the entity (`ENTITIES.<id>.title` of the generated screens is the key of its text).

label.description: The fields that label an item (the book and the reader of a loan: `[book, reader]`), when its resource has no attribute of a label in the contract (`label`: a `name`, a `title`...; S019): the screens give them to the components, which show an item by them, not by its id.

form_values.description: The values of the fields of a form: a scalar, or the labels of the related items of a to-many relationship (`many: true`), which replace those it has (`[]`: none).

step.description: One step of a scenario: an object with exactly one key. Every step acts through the `data-bz` attributes of the screens.

open.description: Open a screen by its route.

open_item.description: Open the item whose fields have these values: a row of a list (the screen of `list.open`), an item of a board or a calendar (its `open`), a row of the last items `in` of a dashboard (their `open`).

in.description: The last items of the dashboard (the id of one of its `recent`).

select.description: On a list with `bulk`, select the row whose fields have these values (`select:<id>`).

bulk.description: Run a bulk action of the list on the selected rows, confirmed.

move.description: On a board with `move`, move the item whose fields have these values to the column of a status, by its menu.

action.description: Run an action of the current screen.

fill.description: Fill fields of the open form.

transit.description: Run a transit on the current card, with its payload.

upload.description: Upload a file (a path relative to e2e/fixtures/ of the frontend) into a file field (`type: file`) of the open form; waits until it is uploaded.

status.description: The status of the current item.

action_absent.description: An action of the current screen that is not shown.

field_readonly.description: A field that the user may not change on the current screen.

field_absent.description: A field of the current screen that the user may not see: not shown.

values.description: Fields of the current card whose shown values contain these texts (a file: its name).

rows.description: The number of rows of the current list.

error.description: A field with a validation error.

notification.description: A notification of the user (bazis-notify or bazis-ws: `packages` has `notify` or `ws`) whose text contains this text, in the list of the notifications.

tile.description: The counts of tiles of the current dashboard, by the id of the tile.

day.description: The numbers of the items of days of the current calendar, by the day: YYYY-MM-DD, or today, today+<n>, today-<n> days from the day of the run (in UTC), as the dates of the data of e2e_data.
